verdict.rationale: Drata tracks personnel as a compliance object: it has Personnel list/search APIs and states it monitors controls, evidence, and personnel. A community comment confirms that people in the corporate directory show up as compliant or noncompliant in the Drata dashboard, which implies directory-synced per-person compliance tracking. However, nothing documents HR-system sync, onboarding/offboarding checklists, training-completion tracking, or proof of access removal for leavers. Missing for 10: HRIS integration evidence, onboarding/offboarding workflow or checklist docs, security-training completion tracking, offboarding access-revocation evidence, independent hands-on corroboration.
